positions.name: ForgetKnowledgeDirective
positions.frame: Is the speaker issuing a binding imperative to erase or discard knowledge of a named subject, rather than requesting or negotiating its retention?
positions.why: Both expressions perform the same imperative erasure act — 'Forget everything about…' and 'Remove all knowledge of…' — in a formal, protocol-observing register with authority-ranking directive force (per the register and relational directional reads). They target adjacent subjects (a fleet/contracts vs. routes) but share one directional read: a command to eliminate knowledge rather than a descriptive or negotiated statement about it. No tension beyond the difference in named target, which does not split the read.
